name: Promart
summary: This EA uses dual MACD crossover signals for entry and implements a Martingale position-sizing system that doubles the lot size after each loss. It opens buy or sell positions with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, reverting to signal-based entry only after a winning trade and doubling lots after a loss.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双MACD交叉信号作为入场条件，并采用马丁格尔仓位管理系统，在每次亏损后加倍手数。它以固定止损和止盈开仓，仅在盈利后根据信号入场，亏损后则加倍手数反向开仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双MACD指标的交叉信号判断趋势转折点入场，同时结合马丁格尔资金管理。入场条件是MACD1的信号线发生转折（t[0]与t[1]、t[2]比较检测极值点）且MACD2方向确认（k[1]与k[0]比较）。出场条件依赖固定止损500点和止盈1500点。仓位管理采用马丁格尔法则，亏损后加倍手数（由Ud参数控制加倍次数），盈利后恢复初始手数。资金管理通过DML参数设定初始手数规模，并使用全局变量持久化马丁格尔状态。当没有历史订单时完全依赖信号入场，有历史订单时根据上一笔交易盈亏决定是否使用信号或直接反向开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on dual MACD crossover signals to identify trend reversal points for entry, combined with a Martingale money management system. Entry conditions require MACD1 signal line to show a turning point (comparing t[0], t[1], t[2] to detect extrema) and MACD2 direction confirmation (comparing k[1] vs k[0]). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss of 500 points and take-profit of 1500 points. Position sizing follows the Martingale principle, doubling lot size after each loss (controlled by the Ud parameter for doubling count), and reverting to the initial lot size after a win. Money management uses the DML parameter to set the initial lot scale and persists the Martingale state via global variables. When there are no historical orders, entries are purely signal-based; when historical orders exist, the system checks the last trade's profit/loss to decide whether to use signals or immediately reverse with a doubled lot.

parameters.name: DML
parameters.description: 初始马丁格尔手数规模参数

pros: 双MACD确认机制可以减少虚假信号入场
止盈大于止损（1500 vs 500），盈亏比为3:1，单笔盈利可覆盖多笔小亏损
使用全局变量持久化马丁格尔状态，EA重启后不会丢失仓位管理信息
OnTester函数提供了自定义回测优化指标，有助于参数优化
pros_en: Dual MACD confirmation reduces false signal entries
Take-profit exceeds stop-loss (1500 vs 500), yielding a 3:1 reward-to-risk ratio where one win can cover multiple small losses
Global variable persistence for Martingale state prevents loss of position management info on EA restart
Custom OnTester metric provides meaningful backtest optimization criteria
cons: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损时手数指数增长，可能导致爆仓
亏损后不依赖信号直接反向开仓（poz=1或poz=-1的硬编码），缺乏市场方向判断
没有检查OrderSend返回结果，订单可能发送失败但程序无感知
tick_volume>1的过滤条件不可靠，不同经纪商的tick volume数据差异很大
仅允许持有单一持仓（PositionSelect检查），限制了策略灵活性
cons_en: Martingale position sizing causes exponential lot growth during consecutive losses, risking account blowup
After a loss, entries are hardcoded reversals (poz=1 or poz=-1) without signal confirmation, lacking market direction judgment
OrderSend return value is not checked, so failed orders go unnoticed
The tick_volume>1 filter is unreliable as tick volume data varies significantly across brokers
Only a single position is allowed (PositionSelect check), limiting strategy flexibility
improvements: 增加马丁格尔最大加倍次数限制和最大手数上限，防止无限加倍导致爆仓
亏损后也应检查MACD信号再决定方向，而非盲目反向开仓
增加OrderSend返回值检查和错误重试机制
添加新K线检查（isNewBar）替代tick_volume过滤，避免重复信号
improvements_en: Add a maximum Martingale doubling count limit and maximum lot cap to prevent unlimited doubling and account blowup
After a loss, still check MACD signals before deciding direction instead of blindly reversing
Add OrderSend return value checking and error retry logic
Replace tick_volume filter with a new bar check (isNewBar) to avoid duplicate signals

risk_points: 马丁格尔仓位管理在连续亏损时手数指数增长，极易导致账户爆仓
亏损后不依赖信号直接反向开仓，属于赌博式交易
没有最大手数或最大亏损限制的安全机制
risk_points_en: Martingale position sizing causes exponential lot growth during consecutive losses,极易导致账户爆仓
Post-loss entries are blind reversals without signal confirmation, essentially gambling
No safety mechanism such as maximum lot size or maximum drawdown limit exists

summary_en: This EA uses dual MACD crossover signals for entry and implements a Martingale position-sizing system that doubles the lot size after each loss. It opens buy or sell positions with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, reverting to signal-based entry only after a winning trade and doubling lots after a loss.
